properties.name: A vocabulary change a consumer's binary cannot read is never silent
properties.statement:
When a design is written under a vocabulary an older reflow2 does not know, that reader must either be told what it lacks or be refused — it must never open the graph and quietly show less of the design than it holds.

**THE MEASURED HOLE, 2026-09-11.** `GraphStamp` carries `reflow2_version`, `schema_version`, node/edge type COUNTS and node/edge type NAMES. That is the complete set of facts a consumer's binary can compare, and it names only TYPES. Every other vocabulary change is invisible to the guard:

· an ENUM VALUE — `Decision.status` gaining `deferred` moves no count and no name, so an older binary opens the graph with no warning, compares `status == "proposed"`, and the decision vanishes from `loop_status` and `what_next`;
· a PROPERTY added to an existing type;
· a SEMANTIC change, where a field's meaning moved and its name did not (`dec:change-type-splits-into-two-axes` is one that already happened).

**This is the harm the guard's own refusal message names** — *"opening it could silently show you less of your design than it holds"* — arriving through the door the guard does not watch. Two thirds of the mechanism is already built: `chg:the-version-guard-refuses-on-a-population-not-a-declaration` refuses rather than degrading, and probes the store for a real population rather than trusting the declaration; `chg:bl86` gave the stamp type-name sets.

⚠️ **WHAT THIS REQUIREMENT DOES NOT DECIDE.** Whether the answer is a wider stamp, per-change identities with names, or a severity per change is open in `dec:idea-a-vocabulary-change-has-no-identity-so-a-consumer-is-told-its-version-is-wrong-not-which-change-it-lacks` — and option (a) is in direct tension with the stamp's own stated reason for being small (*"it must not depend on the vocabulary it is describing"*). The requirement fixes the OBLIGATION, not the mechanism.

**THE BOUND THAT MATTERS.** Being told to migrate is an inconvenience and this project has shown the migration is lossless (3,989 nodes and 21,555 edges in, same out). Reading a design wrong without knowing is the failure this is about, and only the silent case argues for any of it.
